name: Disneyland Galactic Grill American Breakfast Burrito (Scrambled Eggs & Hash Browns)
whyItWorks: Fluffy scrambled eggs, diced bacon, sausage, breakfast hash browns, and cheddar cheese wrapped in a warm soft flour tortilla. Sits smoothly on the gut before Tomorrowland rope drop.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the American Breakfast Burrito with mild salsa on the side (hold spicy pico).
watchOuts: Salsa served on side lets you control acidity
